transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well... I guess my wife wanted me to come in. It's just... she'll be telling me things, like about my cousin's appointments or his rides. And I'll be looking right at her, but... I don't know, a minute later I realize I didn't actually take in half of what she said. So... that's mainly it.
Have you noticed any other changes in your thinking or memory besides having trouble remembering what your wife tells you?

I suppose... just some everyday things. Stuff I meant to do but it just... slips my mind. Like returning a call to the doctor's office, or... picking up a prescription. And I guess I've had some trouble leaving the house on time for my cousin's appointments. But, you know... just things like that.
Do you find it hard to focus or concentrate on tasks, like reading or following a conversation?

I suppose... a little. If I sit down to, say, work out a catering order, or... listen in on a parish planning call, I usually start off fine. But before long... I don't know, my mind just wanders off. I end up having to go back over the same notes, almost like I never even read them in the first place. So... yeah, I guess so.
Have you noticed yourself feeling down, hopeless, or less interested in activities you used to enjoy?
No... not really. I mean, I still enjoy things well enough. Just... maybe a bit frustrated with myself sometimes, but I wouldn't say I feel down or hopeless.
Have you found yourself getting confused about time, like forgetting what day it is, or where you are, or who you're talking to?
No... nothing like that. I know what day it is, and... I know who I'm talking to. I don't get confused about those things.
Have you had trouble organizing your thoughts or finishing tasks that used to be easy for you, like filling out forms or planning an event?

I suppose... maybe. I don't really know about forms or anything. But finishing things... sometimes. I'll start out on something simple, like... setting up my cousin's pill organizer, or just cleaning the prep table after I cook. And then... I'll notice later on that I left a step or two unfinished. I just... don't quite get to the end of it, I guess.
Have you had trouble handling more complicated tasks, like managing finances or organizing a schedule?
No... I don't think so. I handle my bills alright. And I don't really have much of a schedule to keep track of these days, so... no, not really.
Have you had trouble planning or carrying out more complex tasks, like organizing a family event or managing multiple responsibilities at once?
No, I... I don't really do much of that. I don't organize events. And my responsibilities are pretty... straightforward, I guess. So, no.
Have you ever seen, heard, or felt things that others around you don't seem to notice?
No... no, nothing like that. Just... normal things.
Has anyone else, like your wife or other family members, noticed that you're having more trouble with memory or finishing tasks lately?

I guess... yeah. It's caused a little tension at home. My wife... she feels like she can’t really count on me right now with my cousin’s care. And... I don't know, with some catering tasks I help out with, I've had to double-check things a lot more. Sometimes I have to redo them, just so the small jobs don't get mixed up. So... yeah, she's noticed.
Would you say these changes in memory and task completion are affecting your ability to handle daily responsibilities or causing problems in your daily life?
I mean... I guess a little. Like I said, my wife is frustrated. But... I don't know if it's causing huge problems. I'm just... getting by, I suppose.
Have you noticed any changes in your ability to make decisions or understand things that used to make sense to you, like figuring out a problem or understanding a story?
No... not really. I mean, I still understand things fine. Decisions are just... decisions. I haven't noticed any real change with that.
Have you had any trouble with things like judging distances, recognizing familiar places, or telling the difference between colors or shapes?
No, I haven't. I drive fine, and... everything looks the same to me. Nothing like that.
Would you say that these problems with memory and finishing tasks are worse than they used to be, like compared to a year ago?
I guess so, yeah. It's... it's been more noticeable for maybe 11 months or so. That's about when my cousin moved in with us after he had surgery. Just... a lot going on since then, I suppose.
Have you found yourself not wanting to start or finish things, even things you used to do without any trouble?
No... I don't think so. I still want to do things just fine. It's not that I don't want to.
Have you noticed that you're slower to get started on tasks, even things you do regularly, like cooking or helping your cousin?
No, I wouldn't say I'm slower. I just... I get started same as always. It just takes me longer to finish.
Have you found it harder to switch between tasks or think about more than one thing at a time compared to before?
No, I don't think so. I can switch between things alright, I suppose. It's... it's just the finishing part, like I said.
Do you find that even when you're trying your best to focus, you still can't seem to keep your attention on what you're doing, like things around you distract you easily or your mind just goes blank?
No, I wouldn't say my mind goes blank. I just... I get distracted sometimes, I guess. But I can focus when I need to. It's not like I'm completely lost.
Can you describe a time when your memory or ability to finish tasks caused a clear problem in your daily life, like missing an important appointment or making a mistake you wouldn't have made before?

I suppose... well, there's been a little tension at home. My wife, she... she feels like she can't always count on me with my cousin's care lately. And I guess with the catering tasks I do, I've had to start double-checking things. Sometimes redoing them, just so the small jobs don't get mixed up. But... that's about it, really.
Have you ever found yourself so distracted or unfocused that you lose track of what’s going on around you, like not noticing people speaking to you or missing parts of a conversation?

I suppose... yeah, a bit. That's actually sort of what brought me in here. My wife... she'll be telling me about my cousin’s appointments, or rides he needs. And I'll be looking right at her. But then a minute later, I realize I didn’t actually take in half of what she said. I just sort of miss it.
